transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Out on the trails and even back in town, I keep hearing and sensing things from the landscape telling me what to do with my work, and it’s starting to scare me. It feels so incredibly real, and I just don't know what's happening to me.
How long have you been hearing or sensing these messages, and did they come on suddenly over days or weeks, or have they been happening for a longer time?

They started a few months ago during this incredibly revved-up period right after I signed my studio lease, when I was barely sleeping and working constantly. It felt like this sudden, intense wave where the mountains were guiding my choreography, but those voices actually stopped once I crashed into this current low, heavy phase.

Since those experiences started, have you had any other periods like the revved-up, barely sleeping phase, or have the unusual voices and messages continued even when your mood is not elevated or low?

No, those voices and messages completely stopped once I crashed, and they haven't come back at all. I also haven't had another one of those revved-up phases since then. I've just been stuck in this really heavy, low place for the last several months.

Have you ever had a period of at least 1 week where you felt unusually energized or irritable, needed very little sleep, talked more than usual, had racing thoughts, or did risky things, even if you did not hear voices then?

Yes, I had a highly energized period just like that when I first launched the studio earlier this year. I felt completely unstoppable, barely slept for weeks, talked constantly about my ideas, and was incredibly active. But I actually did hear those voices during that exact same high-energy phase, not separate from it.
Have you ever had hallucinations or unusual beliefs when your mood was not high or low, or do they only happen during those energized or depressed periods?

No, they have never happened when my mood was normal. The voices and the feeling of having a special mission only occurred during that highly energized, revved-up period when I wasn't sleeping. Once I crashed into this low, depressed phase, those experiences stopped completely.
How long did that revved-up, energized period last—was it at least 1 week, or did it go on for 4 days or less?

Oh, it lasted much longer than just a week or a few days. It actually went on for about two months of constant, intense activity before I finally hit a wall and crashed. It was weeks and weeks of feeling completely wired and barely sleeping.

During that two-month energized period, did you also have any times of feeling very depressed or losing interest in things for at least two weeks, or was it only the high-energy phase followed by the current low phase?

No, those first two months were purely that high-energy, unstoppable phase. It was only after that period ended that I crashed into this heavy, depressed state, which has dragged on for about nine months now without lifting.
During that two-month high-energy period, did you have any severe problems like needing to be hospitalized, losing touch with reality, or being unable to function at work or in daily life?

I wasn't hospitalized, but I absolutely lost touch with reality, hearing voices from the mountains and being convinced I was chosen for some special artistic mission. My ability to function completely fell apart during that time, and my studio work went into total disarray—I missed major grant deadlines, lost students, and my business partner almost walked away because of my erratic behavior.
During that high-energy period, did you ever need to be hospitalized or did the symptoms make it impossible for you to function safely in daily life?

I wasn't hospitalized, but my functioning was so derailed that a close friend eventually had to convince me to see a psychiatrist to save my studio. During that high period, I was doing things like driving to trailheads at midnight and completely neglecting major business deadlines, and my partner was ready to walk away. It was absolutely impossible for me to run my life or business safely and responsibly.
Have you ever had a major depressive episode before this one, or is this the first time you’ve had a long low period like this?
No, I've never experienced a low period like this before. This is the first time I've ever felt this heavy, exhausted, and completely unable to function.
Have you ever had any similar episodes of unusually high energy, little need for sleep, or feeling ‘wired’ before this year, even if they did not include hallucinations?
No, I haven't really experienced anything like this before this year. This is the very first time I've ever had these kinds of extreme energy shifts and major changes in my sleep.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview supports a bipolar affective disorder with a clear manic episode lasting about 2 months, featuring markedly elevated/activated mood, decreased need for sleep, increased activity, pressured speech, grandiosity/special mission beliefs, hallucinations confined to the manic state, and severe functional impairment. This was followed by a prolonged depressive phase lasting about 9 months. Psychotic symptoms occurred only during mood episodes, making a primary psychotic disorder less likely.
